original_test_intent: Program/verify the same BIOS SPI ROM and image exactly 50 times with SF100, reinstall/restore it and prove normal BIOS boot.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Qualified physical SF100 setup, 50 cycle-numbered program/verify operations, ROM restoration and controlled boot.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: ROM and SUT work normally after stress.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to hybrid REQUIRES; physical setup manual, approved software loop automatable.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: One authorized qualified operator may verify/connect/reinstall; software loop follows one approved plan.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Same ROM/image, exactly 50 cycles, final BIOS boot; 600 minutes is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Target/profile/voltage/topology, actual approved cycle plan and recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Fewer approved cycles complete only that project plan and retain the Master coverage gap.

original_method: Approved DediProg SF100 hardware/software and board-specific programming procedure.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the qualified SF100 automation/logging function for immutable cycle records after manual gate.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved SF100/device-profile and board recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Programmer PASS does not replace reinstall/BIOS boot evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong voltage/pinout/image can brick the ROM/board.

safety_boundaries: Single-operator approval does not waive identity/electrical checks
expected_evidence: Final readback, reinstall and BIOS/health evidence
no_automatic_retry: Failed cycle remains failed; no repeat or image/profile change without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Engineer decides cycle and final boot acceptance.
review_improvement: V3.1 removes the unnecessary two-person verification requirement while retaining exact target, electrical, backup and recovery gates plus explicit override coverage.
